i: eNOAD ≥96 ώρες πριν (αν το ταξίδι <96 h: πριν την αναχώρηση και ≥24 h πριν). Update αν ETA/ETD αλλάξει ≥6 h.
eNOAD ≥96 hours before arrival (voyage <96 h: before departure and ≥24 h before arrival). Update if ETA/ETD changes ≥6 h.
eNOAD ≥96 oras bago dumating (biyahe <96 h: bago umalis at ≥24 h bago dumating). I-update kung magbago ang ETA/ETD ≥6 h.
Χαλασμένος εξοπλισμός (nav, OWS, BWMS κ.λπ.) δηλώνεται ΠΡΙΝ την άφιξη στο COTP/NOA, με σχέδιο επισκευής. Μη δηλωμένο = σοβαρό πρόβλημα.
Inoperative equipment (nav, OWS, BWMS etc.) reported BEFORE arrival to COTP/in NOA, with repair plan. Not reported = serious problem.
Sirang equipment (nav, OWS, BWMS atbp.) i-report BAGO dumating sa COTP/NOA, may plano ng repair. Hindi ni-report = malaking problema.
33 CFR 164.25: ≤12 h πριν την είσοδο, δοκιμή steering gear (main & aux), bridge–steering comms, κ.λπ. + emergency steering drill ≤48 h πριν (ή κάθε 3 μήνες) — όλα στο logbook.
33 CFR 164.25: ≤12 h before entry, test steering gear (main & aux), bridge–steering comms etc. + emergency steering drill ≤48 h before (or every 3 months) — all logged.
33 CFR 164.25: ≤12 h bago pumasok, i-test ang steering gear (main at aux), komunikasyon bridge–steering atbp. + emergency steering drill ≤48 h bago (o kada 3 buwan) — lahat naka-log.
Approved Nontank Vessel Response Plan (≥400 GT) με appendix για το λιμάνι + COFR σε ισχύ — αλλιώς denied entry.
Approved Nontank Vessel Response Plan (≥400 GT) with appendix for the port + valid COFR — otherwise denied entry.
Approved Nontank Vessel Response Plan (≥400 GT) na may appendix para sa port + valid na COFR — kung wala, hindi papapasukin.
Ballast: BWMS με USCG type approval (ή εγκεκριμένη εναλλακτική/extension), BWMP, ballast report πριν την άφιξη. Χαλασμένο BWMS → δήλωση στο COTP.
Ballast: USCG type-approved BWMS (or approved alternative/extension), BWMP, ballast report before arrival. BWMS failure → report to COTP.
Ballast: USCG type-approved na BWMS (o approved alternative/extension), BWMP, ballast report bago dumating. Sira ang BWMS → i-report sa COTP.
VGP 2013 ισχύει ακόμα (μέχρι τους κανονισμούς VIDA): inspections & records VGP, annual report, EAL lubricants στα oil-to-sea interfaces.
2013 VGP still applies (until VIDA rules are in force): VGP inspections & records, annual report, EAL lubricants at oil-to-sea interfaces.
May bisa pa ang 2013 VGP (hanggang VIDA rules): VGP inspection at record, annual report, EAL lubricant sa oil-to-sea interface.
FSMC (gypsy moth): αν το πλοίο πήγε σε Ρωσία ΑΕ/Ιαπωνία/Κορέα/Β. Κίνα σε risk period τους τελευταίους 24 μήνες → pre-departure certificate.
FSMC (gypsy moth): if the ship called Russian Far East/Japan/Korea/N. China in the risk period in the last 24 months → pre-departure certificate.
FSMC (gypsy moth): kung pumunta sa Russian Far East/Japan/Korea/N. China sa risk period sa huling 24 buwan → pre-departure certificate.
North American & US Caribbean ECA: 0,10% S — changeover πριν την είσοδο, log, BDN & samples.
North American & US Caribbean ECA: 0.10% S — changeover before entry, log, BDN & samples.
North American at US Caribbean ECA: 0.10% S — changeover bago pumasok, log, BDN at sample.
Charts & publications για US waters: US Coast Pilot, Light List, Tide & Current tables (ή ισοδύναμα), ENC updated.
Charts & publications for US waters: US Coast Pilot, Light List, Tide & Current tables (or equivalent), ENCs updated.
Chart at publication para sa US waters: US Coast Pilot, Light List, Tide at Current tables (o katumbas), updated ang ENC.

t: What the USCG checks in the exam
i: Oil accumulation στο ER = #1 fire-safety detention 2025: tank tops & bilges καθαρά, χωρίς διαρροές, μονώσεις χωρίς λάδια.
Oil accumulation in ER = #1 fire-safety detention 2025: clean tank tops & bilges, no leaks, no oil-soaked lagging.
Langis sa ER = #1 fire-safety detention 2025: malinis ang tank top at bilge, walang tagas, walang langis sa insulation.
MARPOL Annex I: ORB = soundings = OWS/incinerator records· ποτέ bypass («magic pipe») — η USCG το διώκει ποινικά.
MARPOL Annex I: ORB = soundings = OWS/incinerator records; never a bypass ('magic pipe') — USCG prosecutes criminally.
MARPOL Annex I: ORB = sounding = OWS/incinerator record; bawal ang bypass ('magic pipe') — kinakasuhan ng USCG.
Fire & abandon ship drill μπροστά στον PSCO — «fire drills/crew performance» στους λόγους detention 2025.
Fire & abandon ship drill in front of PSCO — 'fire drills/crew performance' among 2025 detention reasons.
Fire at abandon ship drill sa harap ng PSCO — 'fire drill/crew performance' ay dahilan ng detention 2025.
CO2, fire detection, fire doors, remote means of control — όλα στη λίστα detentions 2025. Δοκίμασέ τα πριν.
CO2, fire detection, fire doors, remote means of control — all on the 2025 detention list. Test them before.
CO2, fire detection, fire door, remote control — lahat nasa detention list 2025. I-test bago dumating.
Garbage: «regulated garbage» (τρόφιμα από ξένα λιμάνια) σε κλειστά δοχεία, όχι στη θάλασσα σε US waters, receipts (USDA/APHIS).
Garbage: 'regulated garbage' (food from foreign ports) in closed containers, no discharge in US waters, receipts (USDA/APHIS).
Basura: 'regulated garbage' (pagkain galing ibang bansa) sa saradong lalagyan, bawal itapon sa US waters, may resibo (USDA/APHIS).
ISPS: έλεγχος πρόσβασης, visitor log, DoS όταν ζητηθεί — η USCG κάνει και security exam.
ISPS: access control, visitor log, DoS when requested — USCG also does a security exam.
ISPS: access control, visitor log, DoS kung hihingin — may security exam din ang USCG.
